messages:
marta: Heads-up — planning a zipper cutover for edge pools in eu-west tonight. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Plan: incremental zipper traffic shift (10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%) with 5m observation windows between steps. Need LB/router coordination and release pinning.

lina: ack. which environment and release are we pinning? :eyes:

marta: prod. pinning to app-service v2.4.1-b1 (artifact: app-service:2.4.1-b1). Please add note about session-affinity "beta" users — they should remain sticky to old pool until 60%.

raj: Rolling drain time request: 90s per instance to avoid sudden p95 jumps. Thoughts?

sam: +1 for 90s. We'll set router config keys: `zipper-window=300s` and `zipper-steps=[10,30,60]` (final step implicit to 100).

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: `/deploy bluegreen router-config --target edge-eu-west --version app-service:2.4.1-b1 --strategy zipper --steps 10,30,60 --pause 300s`

marta: @deploy-bot schedule start at 23:05 UTC if preflight passes. QA slot 22:30-22:55, smoke test 15m after cut.

lina: Preflight status: traffic shadowing for 2h ok, canary sample p95=185ms, infra health checks green. Logs: `preflight: OK`.

raj: Proposing rollback criteria (we should commit these):
- sustained error rate > 1.5% for 3m
- OR p95 latency increase > 50% vs baseline for 3m
- OR HTTP 5xx rate spikes to >2x baseline for 2m
If any triggered, immediate revert to app-service:2.4.0 and route 100% back.

marta: Agreed. Also enable regional fallback pool `edge-eu-west-fallback` as automatic routing fallback on anomalies.

sam: Ops note: when stepping 60->100, temporarily raise circuit-breaker inflight limit to avoid dropped requests. Preflip command:
```
opsctl router set-circuit --pool edge-eu-west --max-inflight 800
```
Run that ~5m before the 60->100 transition.

lina: Drafting release note blurb:
- Zipper cutover: edge-eu-west -> app-service v2.4.1-b1
- Change window: 23:00-01:00 UTC
- Steps: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, 5m observe
- Rollback thresholds: error/p95/5xx as agreed
- Contacts: #eng-releases, oncall: raj

marta: Good. @ops-bot please create a temporary release channel and pin notes.

ops-bot: Created channel `#release-6141592653-eu-west-zipper` and pinned the release notes. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll be watching dashboards (p50/p95/p99, errors, e2e traces). Ping me at 30% and 60% so I can validate tail latencies.

raj: I'll own rollback. If I post `ROLLBACK` in this thread, treat as immediate abort and run: `deploy-bot revert --target edge-eu-west --to-version app-service:2.4.0 --force`

marta: One more ops note — keep session-affinity on old pool until 60% to avoid UX regressions for beta cohort. Lina, can you add that to router flags?

lina: Added flag `affinity-hold=60%` to the job.

marta: Thanks all. Meet at 22:30 for QA. If anything unexpected, call oncall and post here. :thumbsup:
